Yann LeCun on X: "Dario's spiel since GPT-2 has always been about hyping the dangers so that open models would be made illegal and *he* would stay in control. He left OpenAI because he wasn't going to have control. It's like the Ottoman Empire banning the printing press for Arabic so they would keep in control of the dogma. It stops the population from freely accessing diverse knowledge. It's a new form of medieval obscurantism."
